full.També pots tocar un punt a la taula de t: You can also tap a point in the sections table. If you choose a point you have already passed, it calculates the way back along the same path.
full.Pots activar-ne més d'un: s'apilen (el d: You can turn on more than one: they stack (the top of the list on top). The offline download saves the active maps.
full.Descarregar mapes per anar sense cobertu: Download maps for use without signal
full.Descarrega'ls amb wifi abans de la sorti: Download them on wifi before the outing (all route days and active maps). Drag the map to move it; ⦿ centres it again on you. Blue dot: where you really are (GPS). Red dot: the route point used for the figures; it only shows when you are off route, with a line to the path.
full.Minuts de parada a cada punt. Compten a: Stop minutes at each point. They count in planned times, limit times, «To the end» and plan B options. By default, a first 10-min stop at the first point (water and layers).
full.Temps de marxa per tram = màx(dist./3,5: Walking time per section = max(dist./3.5 km/h ; up/300 + down/400) × 1.2. «Planned»: arrival time from the planned start, including planned stops (+min = stop at that point). «Actual» is recorded when you pass the point; with ≈ if the phone was locked. «Limit»: latest time to do all of plan A = planned + the margin up to the target time (max. 1 h 30). If you pass it late, you can still go on to the relevant plan B (see each plan B's decision time). In red if you passed after the limit.
full.Toca un altre cop per esborrar inici i h: Tap again to clear start and times
full.Mou el punt pel track per provar l'app a: Move the point along the track to try the app at home (no GPS used).
full.Sense hora simulada, l'app suposa que pa: Without a simulated time, the app assumes you pass each point at the planned time. Set a time (or tap «Now») to see how you'd be doing and which plan B applies.
full.Funciona sense cobertura un cop oberta u: Works without signal once opened online. You can keep the phone locked: when unlocked, the app places you on the track again and the km and ascent done include everything walked meanwhile (time counts from the start). The real trace with the screen off is not recorded: if you leave the track, record with your GPS device. Km and ascent are calculated on the track (5 m filter), not with the phone's altimeter.
full.Plans B calculats sobre els camins d'Ope: Plan B options calculated on OpenStreetMap paths: check them on the ground and with the heatmap. On the map, dashed orange.

full.: valorar la víctima, mantenir-la calent: : assess the casualty, keep them warm and insulated from the ground, and keep the phone free so they can call you.
full.Ferit que no pot caminar o hipotèrmia am: Injured person who can't walk, or hypothermia with confusion:
full.no baixar-lo a peu. Abrigar, aïllar de t: don't walk them down. Keep warm, insulate from the ground and wait for rescue.
full.provar l'SMS, pujar a un collet o carena: try SMS, climb to a col or ridge, or send two people with the coordinates written down. The group never splits without someone in charge of each part.
full.si el contacte extern no té notícies a l: if the external contact hasn't heard from you by the agreed time, they call 112.

full.Carrega el GPX de la ruta (track i waypo: Load the route GPX (track and roadbook waypoints, e.g. exported from your GPS app). For several days, one GPX per day or one GPX with one track per day.

full.Encara som als cotxes: si falta alguna c: We're still at the cars: if anything is missing, now is the time.

full.botes de muntanya; bastons si en feu ser: hiking boots; poles if you use them.
full.Si algú es perd de vista: es queda quiet: If anyone loses sight of the group: stay put and call me. No signal: 112.

full.No deixem rastre: les deixalles, a la mo: Leave no trace: rubbish goes in your backpack. Questions? … Let's go!

full.On som (de més general a més concret): Where we are (from general to specific)
